text:
Amit Regev 

1. Correct -the first page is a checklist only. 
2. Any place that you see this image means there needs to be a lawyer or a court registrar signature. It needs to be done in person and cannot be done digitally. Page 5 definitely does need to be signed in front of a lawyer - it is a bunch of important personal declarations. 
3. Regarding the landlord affidavit, some PIBA branches do not require this - but it is hard to say in advance what will be needed. You should provide as much as you can - a copy of the lease. Maybe a signed letter from the person you are subleasing from confirming you live there (plus a copy of their ID card) could be accepted. But they may insist on the affidavit.
